Aps0AttachAttrGroup is a POM Revisable class which extends the ImanRelation class. It is used to attach Aps0MagThread to Owning Business Object.

Application should sub-type this POM Revisable class when they need to manage a group of related attributes for their Business Object where different access rules are required for the Group of attributes than for the primary element.

Aps0EffectivityExprBlock associates the functionality provided by Fnd0EffectivityExprBlock. It is used instead of Fnd0effectivityExprBlock because configurable application objects support minor versions and hence the Aps0EffectivityExprBlock must also support minor versions.

An Aps0MAGThread is an anchor object that multiple revisions of a Aps0ManagedAttributeGroup share in common. Customers can subtype this Thread to host common attributes across all revisions of the MAG.
Applications should sub-type this POM Revisable class when they need to manage a group of related attributes in a separate lifecycle than the primary Object. This class is Major Revisable.

Last modified date of secondary object (or ancillary supporting objects) used when data in the primary object was last synchronized with data from the secondary object.

TcStandardType.description: Mdl0AttachAttrGroup is a relation class which is used to attach Attribute Group and Managed Attribute Group objects to Model Elements for the purpose of customer specific extensions of groups of extra attributes (similar to the concept of form objects). Mdl0AttachAttrGroup is inherited from Copy Stable Relation to inherit the behavior required to relate objects to a sparse objects. Mdl0AttachAttrGroup is POM revisable.Mdl0AttachAttrGroup is used to attach Mdl0ManagedAttrGroup and Mdl0AttributeGroup objects to Rlz0RealizationMap object in case of sparse elements. This relation can also be used to attach Mdl0AttributeGroup to Mdl0ModelElement object.This business object can be extended by internal downstream applications or external customers. However, the customization will also require the creation of a custom relation type to support the downstream implementation of the custom Mdl0AttachAttrGroup.

Mdl0CopyStableRelation extends the ImanRelation class and has POM versioning behavior. Applications using this business objects should sub-type this relation for specific uses that require a copy-stable identity for the relation or require POM versioning of the relation. Use of POM versioning relation is required if relating objects that also support POM versioning.

TcProperty.description: If set to true, synchronize secondary revision by setting the mdl0secondary_revision_lmd value to the relevant date of the current secondary object. This signifies that the secondary data as of that date has been synchronized with data on the primary object. This should only be done after making any required changes to the primary object. Depending on the secondary object type, the new secondary revision date tracked will be taken from among mdl0position_lmd, mdl0shape_lmd, last_mod_date, lsd (last saved date) attributes. E.g. if secondary object is a Mdl0PositionedModelElement, then latest date of mdl0position_lmd and mdl0shape_lmd is taken.If false, the mdl0secondary_revision_lmd value is reset to NULLDATE.fnd0CopyStableDate (on ImanRelation class level) is also synchronized likewise.
